context: The RISC-V Privileged Specification lists machine-mode CSRs organized into Machine Information Registers, Machine Trap Setup, Machine Trap Handling, Machine Configuration, and Machine Memory Protection categories, including registers such as mvendorid, mstatus, mepc, menvcfg, and pmpaddr.
